Open a WebSocket to --to, send a Plivo-format start frame, stream synthetic
audio for --duration seconds, then stop. Reports connection latency,
frame send rate, and any disconnects.

No call is placed and no Plivo backend interaction occurs — this is a
pure-client tool that verifies your handler can accept the Plivo stream
shape before you wire it up to a real number.

Usage:
  plivo voice streams test [flags]

Examples:
  plivo voice streams test --to wss://my-bot.example.com/ws
  plivo voice streams test --to ws://localhost:7860/ws --duration 5
  plivo voice streams test --to wss://localhost:7860/ws --insecure   # self-signed dev cert
  plivo voice streams test --to wss://my-bot.example.com/ws --bidirectional

Flags:
      --bidirectional   also read frames back from the endpoint (test bot→caller path)
      --codec string    audio codec: mulaw | l16 (default "mulaw")
      --duration int    seconds of synthetic audio to stream (max 30) (default 3)
  -h, --help            help for test
      --insecure        skip TLS verification (self-signed dev certs only)
      --rate int        sample rate in Hz (8000 for mulaw, 16000 typical for l16) (default 8000)
      --to string       WebSocket URL of the endpoint to test (ws:// or wss://, required)

Global Flags:
      --all                auto-paginate through all pages
      --api-url string     override the REST API base URL (or set PLIVO_API_URL) — for pointing at a non-production gateway
      --dry-run            print the HTTP request without sending
      --explain            explain what the command will do before executing
      --log-level string   log level: debug|info|warn|error|none (default "warn")
      --no-color           disable colored output
  -o, --output string      output format: table|json (default: table for TTY, json otherwise)
      --profile string     named profile from ~/.plivo/config.toml
  -q, --quiet              suppress non-data output
      --timeout int        request timeout in seconds (default 30)
  -y, --yes                skip confirmation prompts
